title: Financial conflicts of interest and reporting bias regarding the association between sugar-sweetened beverages and weight gain: a systematic review of systematic reviews
authors: Bes-Rastrollo M, Schulze MB, Ruiz-Canela M, Martinez-Gonzalez MA
funder: No funding was received for this work.
authorConflicts: The authors declared that no competing interests exist.
result: 17 systematic reviews with 18 conclusions on sugar-sweetened beverages and weight gain or obesity. Five of 6 conclusions (83.3%) from reviews disclosing a financial conflict of interest with the food industry found insufficient evidence of a positive association; 10 of 12 conclusions (83.3%) from reviews reporting no such conflict found a potential risk. Relative risk of a conclusion of no positive association 5.0 (95% CI 1.3 to 19.3).
